title: Elemental
desc: A determined man, Partha Sarathy, fights social injustice, climbs from tough streets to police, and battles a powerful Don and his criminal empire.

title: Thor: Ragnarok
desc: Thor is imprisoned on the planet Sakaar, and must race against time to return to Asgard and stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his world, at the hands of the powerful and ruthless villain Hela.

title: Avatar: The Way Of Water
desc: Jake Sully's family seeks refuge with an ocean tribe on Pandora, facing human attacks. They bond with the sea, fight for survival, and protect their home in this sci-fi epic.

title: Kingdom Of The Planet Of The Apes
desc: In a distant future, warring apes seek human tech while one enslaves others; a freedom-seeking ape partners with a young human woman with her own aims.

title: The Angry Birds Movie 2 2019
desc: Red and friends must team with pigs to stop Zeta from conquering both islands. They face a tough, honest truce and Red's potential change.

title: Deadpool
desc: Ajax, a twisted scientist, experiments on Wade Wilson, a mercenary, to cure him of cancer and give him healing powers. However, the experiment leaves Wade disfigured and he decides to exact revenge.

title: Die Hard 2
desc: When a team of terrorists threaten to destroy an airport and demand the release of the drug lord Ramon Esperanza, detective John tries to stop them.

title: Nezha
desc: The Hanji Box tells a moving cross-cultural story where art, heritage, and human connection lead to healing and self-discovery.
